title: MOBCAL method file, ccs-method version 1
description: A method: everything a calculation depends on but its input. The core (name, description, gas, temperature, seed) is what any program's method has; the mobcal block holds what MOBCAL's has: the random number generator, the five sampling counts and the element table, carried whole. The file is JSON, NAME.method.json, and this schema checks it as it stands. docs/methods.md is the specification. The rules that need more than the document's structure are checked by mobcal.methods and listed on that page: every number token of the table is spelled with its column's declared kind (a d exponent for double, none for single) and is greater than zero, and only the two expressions the 2012 source wrote hold an operator; the element keys are unique; the table's rows hash to its rows_sha256; shipped is true exactly when sha256 is the pin of one of the gas's shipped tables, and a shipped table equals that file field for field; the name must differ from the shipped methods' and from every other method in the list; the temperature must be finite; the version, the five counts, the seed and the element keys are written as integers (1000, not 1000.0 or 1e3, which this schema takes as integers); itn x inp x imp is at most 9,999,999; a key may appear only once; and the name is refused when it holds any character Python's str.isprintable rejects, of which this schema refuses only the controls.

name.description: What the Method list and the run record show: 1 to 60 printable characters, no space at either end.

description.description: What the method is, in a sentence or two: the Method list's tooltip. Not part of what identifies the calculation.

seed.description: The first seed of a run of this method; 5013489, the 2012 seed, when left out.

mobcal.description: What only MOBCAL's method has. Every key is required.

imp.description: Trajectories per block of the trajectory method; 1000 in 2012.

itn.description: Cycles of the trajectory method; 10 in 2012.

inp.description: Velocity points of the trajectory method; 40 in 2012.

inum.description: Trajectories of the projection approximation and exact hard-sphere pass (helium); 250000 in 2012.

inor.description: Reflections followed per hard-sphere trajectory (helium); 30 in 2012.

table.description: The element table, whole: the tree of the TOML file it was taken from (docs/parameters.md, format 1), every number a string holding the Fortran literal, plus sha256 (of that TOML file), rows_sha256 (of the rendered table from its second line on) and shipped.

name.description: The table's name: letters, digits, blanks and ._()+- with no blank at either end.

combining.description: The constants that combine a combining table's self parameters with the gas; double precision.

key.description: The integer mass key the .mfj carries.

token.description: A Fortran real literal as the source spells it (digits, one point, digits, an optional d exponent), or one of the two expressions the 2012 source wrote.
